Can I get the app yet?
TrustinJr is in development and testing. No public launch date or pricing is announced. Apple Watch is for the child; iPhone holds the Parent Dock. The current beta requires normal pairing; Family Setup onboarding remains unresolved. Check availability before buying a device.
Is that the real app design?
The hero recreates the native Curiosity screen with its current layout and original artwork. The floating feature tour belongs to this website. The separate interactive preview uses prepared samples, with no live AI or microphone.
What should parents know about the AI?
AI can make mistakes. Family preferences add to essential safeguards; they do not replace adult judgment or relationships. This preview uses prepared content, not live AI or a microphone. Read the parent guide or our website privacy notice.
